[[Eye of Argon]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Corporal Argon]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Jahai Bluffs]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Command]])
:Reduces [[Blind]] duration on you by 20% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Sharktooth Shield]], [[dye]]d gray.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Command]] [[shield]]s:
**[[Daedal Shield]] from collectors [[Pathfinder Mia]] or [[Fopp]]
**[[Goldleaf Defender]] from collectors [[Cait]] or [[Dagnor Grubeater]]
**[[Destroyer Shield]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Shield]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Shield]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|I Can See Clearly Now]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Command]] [[shield]]s:
**[[Heraldic Shield]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Shield]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Shield]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Shield]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Shield]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Shield]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Shield of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Shield of the Wing]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Charr Shield]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Mursaat Shield]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Shield]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)

==Unique counterpart==
*[[Bei Chi's Bulwark]] has stats identical to this item.

==Trivia==
* [[wikipedia:The Eye of Argon|The Eye of Argon]] is the name of an infamous short story popularly known as "the worst science fiction story ever written".
* This item is referenced in ''Guild Wars 2'' with its [[GW2:Branded Eye of Argon|Branded Eye of Argon]] item.
